current.dispatch_timeframe: Next day dispatch from our UK warehouse — arrives in 1–3 working days.
current.response_time_text: Within 24 hours everyday except Fridays and Sundays — those are our rest days.
current.founder_note_body: GBG started because I got tired of watching women give up on reselling, not because they weren't capable, but because nobody could give them a straight answer without gatekeeping. I built this to be the source I needed when I started: real stock, honest prices, and someone who actually answers when you ask a question. Every part of this hub — the shop, the guides, the community — comes from that same place. Thank you for being part of it.
current.returns_policy_body:
We want you to feel confident ordering from GBG Wholesale Hub. This page will hold our full returns and refund policy — final wording is being confirmed with Lami.

In the meantime: if an order arrives damaged, faulty, or incorrect, contact us within 48 hours of delivery with your order number and photos, and we'll sort it out. Wholesale stock bought at low MOQs is generally sold as-is once received in good condition.
current.privacy_policy_body:
This page will hold our full privacy policy, confirming exactly what customer data we collect, how it's used, and your rights over it. Final wording is being confirmed with Lami before launch.

In short: we only use your details to process orders, provide support, and — with your consent — send you restock and community updates. We never sell your data.
current.terms_body:
This page will hold our full terms of service. Final wording is being confirmed with Lami before launch.

In short: GBG Wholesale Hub supplies ready-stock products at low minimum order quantities for resale or personal use. Placing an order means you agree to pay the listed wholesale price and accept stock as described at time of dispatch.
current.track_order_body: Every order ships from our UK warehouse and you'll receive a shipping confirmation email with tracking as soon as it's on its way. Signed in? Your full order history and live tracking links are in your account below. Ordered as a guest? Use the order lookup below, or message us on WhatsApp with your order number.
